resolution: The new live gv_churntrace data showed the previous chrome/PropertiesPanel churn was gone and the remaining spike was coming from PaintCanvas overlay churn: HoverReadout update-text was changing coordinate strings such as bt53 -> bp54 -> bl55 while BrushCursor updated or removed its two-node view. That matched the GLYPH RASTERIZE +72/+75 and frame-hash flip in the user's log. I changed PaintCanvas so brush-mode cursor updates clear the coordinate readout instead of changing text during brush movement, the HoverReadout and BrushCursor sink setters now return the previous state when the semantic value did not change, and BrushCursor hides with a stable zero-size shell instead of returning null for the common no-cursor case. This targets only the named overlay churn and does not touch game timing, data, or unrelated editor state. Built with SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship hmsc-int and verified ./tools/rjit game verify green; live user confirmation is still required for PASS.
